anchors: pool_components.tsv from v3 (2859 components); anchor spots plus one-ring neighbors excluded from readout (Visium ~100um ring; HD/Xenium 55um ring)
b_axis_control: B panel (49 voted genes, marker_proxy_combined.json classes.B); scored with the same AUCell operator; B halo around B hotspots is itself an unanswered question, reported not assumed
circularity_rule: Detection used B/plasma/chemokines. Immune readouts are reported with the circular flag; only tumor-intrinsic sets (G2M/EMT/MYC/MKI67/COL1A1) and B-vs-immune shape contrasts can carry non-circular weight.
distance_primary: absolute micron bins common to all platforms: edges 0,100,...,1000; per-bin minimum spots required, missing bins stay missing (no imputation); per-anchor extent recorded
distance_sensitivity: per-anchor min-max rescale 0-1 + natural spline df=3 (paper emulation only)
field_gate: distance structure (monotone or directional, not noise)
beats composition controls (B shape/amplitude + clean tumor-intrinsic sets)
gobp_rule: deferred. If Hallmark is optimistic, a SEPARATE decision freezes the GOBP merge map (family merge report-layer only, D-136 precedent) before any GOBP run. No silent expansion.
new_external_data_note: No download was performed. The GMT file was already present at data/geneset/h.all.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt (user-supplied, sha256 pinned below). The D-111 approval rule stands for any future fetch.

operators.P0_angular_bins: first. Polar (r,theta) per anchor; 4 sectors x radial bands 100-200/200-400/400-700/700-1000; corridor sector vs perpendicular sector paired diff; cross-anchor median; direction claims only from r>=200um (Visium angular resolution)
operators.P1_corridor_control: with P0. Same geometry; raw AUCell first, Q+C residual as second pass
operators.P2_gradient_vectors: gated on P0/P1 positive. Finite-difference gradient alignment; rotation null only
operators.P3_oriented_filters: gated on P0/P1 positive. Gabor/ridge bank; rotation null only

readout_panel.note: User override of D-159 small panel. GOBP merge only if optimistic, under a separate freeze.

round_cap_note: Bounded attempt: P0/P1 on all pool sections in one run. P2/P3 only if P0/P1 positive. GOBP only under a separate freeze.
xenium_rule: frozen (subcellular regime; panel covers only 20/57 of the detection signature). Visium family only (HD pseudo-grid counts as sensitivity).
